- [x] TASK-TITLE-LAYOUT-1 — Fix the title screen: the campaign panel is pinned off-centre, the menu buttons overlap each other, and Duel Arena runs off the bottom of the screen. All of it is in client/scripts/Main.cs. Do the steps below IN ORDER.
    WHY — Trikzos sent a screenshot of the live title screen. I read the code and measured it; these are the three real causes, not guesses. (1) OFF-CENTRE PANEL: BuildSlotPicker creates _slotPickerContainer as a bare Control anchored 0.20-0.80 horizontally, then does _slotPickerContainer.AddChild(slotCard) with NO anchors and no preset on slotCard. A bare Control performs no layout, so the PanelContainer collapses to its own minimum size and sits at the container's top-left corner — which is x = 0.20 * viewport width. At 2316 wide that is x=463, and that is exactly where the "No Campaign / New Campaign" box appears in the screenshot. It is not centred because nothing ever centres it. (2) OVERLAPPING BUTTONS: the five menu buttons are hand-anchored and two of the bands collide — newAccountBtn is AnchorTop 0.67 / AnchorBottom 0.75 while decksButton is 0.65 / 0.73. decksButton is added second so it paints on top, which is why "Create New Account" is nowhere on screen: it is behind the Decks button and unclickable. _statusLabel at 0.93-0.97 also collides with the Settings and Duel Arena bands. (3) OFF-SCREEN BUTTON: every stone button carries CustomMinimumSize = (0, ThemeTokens.MinButtonHeight) and MinButtonHeight is 120. At 1080 tall, an 0.08 anchor band is 86px and an 0.06 band is 65px, so EVERY button is 34-55px taller than the band it was given. arenaButton is the worst: band 0.94-1.00, 65px for a 120px button, anchored flush to the bottom edge — so it grows straight off the screen. That is the clipped "Duel Arena".
    STEP 1 — Centre the campaign panel. In BuildSlotPicker, immediately after _slotPickerContainer.AddChild(slotCard), add: slotCard.SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(Control.LayoutPreset.FullRect); so the card actually fills its container instead of collapsing to the top-left. Then change _slotPickerContainer's anchors to AnchorLeft = 0.34f, AnchorRight = 0.66f, AnchorTop = 0.32f, AnchorBottom = 0.54f. Do not change slotCard's CustomMinimumSize or its stylebox.
    STEP 2 — Replace the hand-anchored button stack with a real container. DELETE the five separate AddChild calls and all their AnchorTop/AnchorBottom lines for: newAccountBtn, decksButton, reliquaryButton, settingsButton, arenaButton. Keep MakeStoneButton and keep every Pressed handler exactly as it is — only the layout changes. In their place build one VBoxContainer anchored AnchorLeft = 0.22f, AnchorRight = 0.78f, AnchorTop = 0.56f, AnchorBottom = 0.96f, with AddThemeConstantOverride("separation", 16). Into that VBox add, in this order: (a) a GridContainer with Columns = 2 and AddThemeConstantOverride("h_separation", 16) and ("v_separation", 16), holding Decks, Reliquary, Settings, Duel Arena in that reading order, each with SizeFlagsHorizontal = Control.SizeFlags.ExpandFill; (b) the "Create New Account" button, also SizeFlagsHorizontal = Control.SizeFlags.ExpandFill, full width beneath the grid.     Why this shape and not a single column: five stacked 120px buttons plus their gaps need 664px, which does not fit under a 216px title block and a campaign panel on a 1080-tall screen. Two rows of two plus one full-width row needs 2*120 + 16 + 16 + 120 = 392px, and the 0.56-0.96 band is 432px at 1080. That fits with 40px of slack. Both title captures are 1080 tall (2316x1080 and 2999x1080), so height is the same in both and only the width changes — at 2316 each grid cell is about 648px wide, at 2999 about 840px, so no label is tight.

  a tactician: each turn enumerate candidate plays (card × lane, ritual targets) and attack
  sets, look one ply ahead, and score the result: face vigor for both sides weighted by how
  close either is to lethal; creature value = attack + vigor + keyword worth; favorable
  trades (kill without dying) rewarded; attacking into a blocker that kills you is only
  allowed when it clears the way to lethal; Guard lanes respected; artifact charge progress
  valued; hold a cheap card rather than dump the hand into a Guard wall. Deterministic under
  the match seed. Difficulty knob in encounter json: "ai": "greedy" | "tactician" — default
  tactician everywhere, bosses always tactician.
  Acceptance: tactician beats greedy at least 65% over 200 seeded mirrors, reported per class
  in plain words; the 5-duel soak and loop_smoke still pass; no shipped card value changes.
